summary:
Independent review of Jinshu 086 owned units s0002–s0210 (minus s0140) covering Zhang Gui, Zhang Shi, and the Liangzhou cast through the Chang'an fall. Year-level conversions that rest on the Chinese itself are supported: 永甯初 as Hui Di Yongning 1 / AD 301; 永興中 as Yongxing AD 304–306; 永嘉初 as Huai Di Yongjia 1 / AD 307; 湣帝即位 and 建興初 as Min Di Jianxing 1 / AD 313; 四載於茲 / 逼遷天子 as Jianxing 4 / AD 316. Unyeared sequels after 永嘉初 correctly use onOrAfter 307 without a second endpoint. 漢末 anecdotes stay unresolved. Gui's 卒年六十 is kept as traditional inclusive sui and is not turned into a birth year; 在州十三年 versus conventional Jianxing 2 leaves the 313/314 death open on both Gui records and on Shi's succession. Retrospective citations (ancestral names, Han precedents, 諡曰武公, 討曹祛, 劉載 in the edict) are not used as living activity. Defects that block approval: s0007 泰始初 is Gui receiving office through uncle Xi, yet p005 carries AD 265–265; Hui's 惠帝遣加 is closed to Yongxing though the Chinese does not date the honor; Suo Fu, the 是時 Beidi raid, Qu Tao, and Xin Pan are given invented Jianxing 1 / 313–313 years; Liu Yao's 自去年九月 is dropped from the 316 campaign window; Min's death is dated 316 from 逼遷 rather than from later 崩問; and three hint sets overstate Lang's Shanggui march, Rui's being named while 遠在江表, and Bao's undated 會保薨 as 318–320 / Taixing 3.
Independent review of Jin Shu 86 owned units s0211–s0420 (skipping unowned s0254/s0313) against the Chinese text only. Conventional reign-year labels used where the source writes them (建興四年 / 太興三年 / 是歲建興六年 / 二年 after 建興初) convert as 建興 313–316, 太興 318–321, 永昌 322–323, 太寧 323–326, 咸和 326–334; year-only labels are not treated as Gregorian month/day dates, and there is no year 0. Surviving supported chronology includes the Shanggui/Jianxing-6 cluster windows, Zhang Shi’s Taixing 3 murder, Zhang Mao’s 314 summons and 320 accession with unresolved Taining death, Zhang Jun’s 316 enfeoffment and 18 sui, honest unresolved Taining/Fuhan/heir rows, 咸和初 sequels kept as onOrAfter 326, and retrospective citations kept off life dates. Defects are concentrated in four over-precise conversions (建興初→313, 歲餘→Taixing 4, 明年→Yongchang 1, 咸和初→326–327), Yuan Di’s death day imported from 崩問, Min’s death year used as an active hint, an unflagged 太寧元年 reception on the 少帝 citation, two “before Yongchang 1” hints that exclude 322, and Zhang Jun’s omitted 十歲 age. Competing Jin Shu / Tongjian Taining witnesses are preserved where the extraction already marked them unresolved.
Owned units s0421–s0629 (except s0494) were read in Chinese. Numbered Jin years convert as conventional year-only labels: 太興二年 = AD 319 (Yuan), 咸和八年 = 333 and 九年 = 334 (Cheng), 永和元年 = 345 and 二年 = 346 (Mu). No owned event gives a month/day that would require restating a Western year in proleptic Gregorian; Academia Sinica’s pre-1582 Julian default is therefore not applied as an offset. 咸和初 and the 及/至是/後/自後 sequels are mostly handled as onOrAfter 326 or 334 with unresolved:true. The long 永和二年 war-and-court sequel is likewise onOrAfter 346, not a closed later Yonghe year. Ages 四十 / 十六 / 二十七 stay as sui. Posthumous 追諡 and 季龍自斃 / 勒雄既死 / 九泉 citations are reception and do not feed life dates or active hints. Two date rows invent closed intervals: claim-230 / hints-p190 turn 咸和初 plus later sequels into AD 326–327, and claim-257 / hints-p211 close Ma Ji’s unnumbered 上言 as AD 345–345. Seven owned people have explicit deaths in the Chinese (殺劉曜; 自刎而死; 戮李嘉; 斬杜勳、汲魚; 弘、悠皆沒) with no death predicate. Zhang Jun’s death bound 345–346 and Chonghua’s unresolved death onOrAfter 346 are supported from the narrative sequence; later 354 honors were not used as life dates.
Independent review of Jinshu 86 from Yaoling's succession through the historian's appraisal. Conventional year-only conversions hold: Yonghe 10 / Jianxing 42 / Heping 1 = AD 354; Jianxing 43 = 355; Jianxing 49 / Shengping adoption = 361; Xingning 1 = 363; 太和初 on or after 366; Taiyuan 1 = 376; 隆安中 = 397–401; 淮肥 = Taiyuan 8 / 383. Those labels are conventional Western years, not proleptic Gregorian day dates. Ages 十歲, 十八九, 年十四, and 年六十一 are preserved; 尋卒 and the two 賜諡 grants stay unresolved. Defects: Yi Chuai, Zhang Ling, and Zhang Song are locked to an invented Yonghe 11 / 355–355, while Jinshu only rails Zuo's last campaign between 永和十年 and 建興四十三年. The Lian Qi–Li Yan–Wang Meng campaign and Dahuai's heir appointment are locked to Taihe 1 / 366–366, which Jinshu does not write; ZZTJ has Taihe 2 and a 晉記 witness has Taihe 3. Chang Ju's Taiyuan 1 attestation cites the earlier undated 征東 title. Lady Ma (p279) is omitted at s0688. Xuanjing's 私諡/賜諡 and Tianxi's 追贈 are omitted receptions, and Tianxi's hints stop at 366+ despite 太元元年 and 淮肥.

findings.problem: s0007 泰始初，受叔父錫官五品 dates Zhang Gui's fifth-rank office through uncle Zhang Xi. The extraction gives Xi a closed AD 265–265 life year and leaves Gui without that dated office.
findings.action: Remove the Taishi interval from p005/hints-p005 (Xi stays an undated kinsman). Record 泰始初 on p001 as Gui's own attestation; conventional Taishi 1 = AD 265 as a reign-year label, not a December/January Gregorian day (Taishi opened in the last lunar month of 265).

findings.problem: Emperor Hui's honor (s0024 惠帝遣加) is written after the 永興中 victory but is not itself dated 永興.
findings.action: Replace the AD 304–306 closed interval with westernBounds onOrAfter AD 304 and sync the Hui hint. Do not invent an end year from Hui's later death.

findings.problem: After 湣帝即位 the coinage speech, 是時 Beidi raid, Qu Tao dispatch, and Xin Pan mission have no 建興元年. Closed AD 313–313 is a guessed year.
findings.action: Use westernBounds onOrAfter AD 313 from 湣帝即位, or mark unresolved. Rewrite sourceDate to the Chinese (是時 / 索輔言 / 帝遣) and drop Jianxing-1 exact-year hints.

findings.problem: The 316 surrender edict itself says 劉曜自去年九月. If 四載於茲 is Jianxing 4 / AD 316, that ninth month is AD 315. The 316–316 window hides it.
findings.action: Keep 會劉曜逼長安 and 自去年九月. Date the campaign as AD 315–316 or with bounds from that ninth month through the 316 forced move. Do not apply a one-year label to the whole war.

findings.problem: Emperor Min's death is dated AD 316 from 四載於茲 / 逼遷天子. Those clauses are the surrender and forced move. The chapter's 崩 is later 湣帝崩問 (s0229), after the Shanggui march, not the fall itself.
findings.action: Do not use 316 as the death year. Date 逼遷/陷沒 as the 316 event; keep 崩 separate. From this chapter Min is alive at 將降 (316) and already dead when 崩問 arrives in the later cluster. That is a bound or unresolved death, not AD 316 exact. Do not import an external 318 killing as a closed year.

findings.problem: Zhang Lang's owned 316 row is the first eastward dispatch (s0201). The extra exact-year 'Shanggui-relief cluster' hint overstates a later march that is only after 316.
findings.action: Keep the 316 dispatch hint. Drop or rewrite the Shanggui hint as onOrAfter 316 to match the context bound.

findings.problem: AD 316 is attached to Sima Rui because Min's edict names the Prince of Langye 遠在江表. That is a mention, not Rui's activity.
findings.action: Remove 316 from Rui's active hints. Keep later 太興 accession from context as his own event. claim-125 may remain as edict context if it is not treated as living activity.

findings.problem: Sima Bao's 316 letter is supported. The hint 'AD 318–320 (after Jianxing 6, before Taixing 3)' invents Taixing 3 / 320 and contradicts onOrAfter 318. s0243 會保薨 has no year in the supplied units.
findings.action: Keep the 316 letter. For the later self-declaration and death use onOrAfter 318 only, or unresolved. Do not print 320 unless a Chinese year is produced.

findings.problem: s0257 writes 建興初 for Sima Bao’s appointment of Zhang Mao, not 建興元年. The closed Jianxing 1 / AD 313–313 interval invents year-1 precision.
findings.action: Replace the date-context with sourceDate 建興初 and either unresolved:true (初 is not year 1) or a one-sided/open early-Jianxing bound; do not print 313–313. Clear the matching hint.

findings.problem: The terrace speeches sit under 歲餘 after 太興三年. sourceDate Taixing 4 / closed AD 321–321 rewrites 歲餘 as an exact reign year.
findings.action: Date Yan Zeng, Xin Yan, and Ma Fang from 歲餘 after 太興三年 with a sequence window (after 320, before 永昌初 / Mao’s death), not a closed 321 interval. Synchronize hints.

findings.problem: s0272 dates this campaign 明年 after the 歲餘 terrace, not 永昌元年. Closed Yongchang 1 / AD 322–322 converts a relative year into an exact reign year. claim-163 also fuses that 明年 defence with the later 永昌初 Longxi strike.
findings.action: Give the 明年 participants the same 320–322 sequence window already used for Liu Yao (claim-168) and Fan Yi (claim-170). Split Han Pu’s 明年 defence from 永昌初. Do not label 明年 as Yongchang 1.

findings.problem: Liu Yao’s 明年 campaign and Wu Shao’s 未幾 remonstrance are correctly bounded onOrBefore 322, but the hints say “before Yongchang 1,” which excludes AD 322. An event before 永昌初 can still fall in 322.
findings.action: Rewrite the hints to onOrBefore 322 / before 永昌初 inclusive of 322, matching claim-168 and claim-172.

findings.problem: s0343 writes 咸和初, not 咸和元年 or 咸和二年. The closed AD 326–327 interval invents an end year. Tongjian dates the Qinzhou/Wogan campaign to 咸和二年; that is a competing witness to keep unresolved, not a second endpoint to print. Context claim-472 already treats 咸和初 as onOrAfter 326.
findings.action: Replace the 326–327 closes with unresolved:true or onOrAfter 326, preserving 咸和初 against Tongjian 二年. Keep Song Ji’s separate 316–318 Shanggui hint; drop only the illegal Xianhe close.

findings.problem: s0336 attests 尋承元帝崩問 only. The death day 永昌元年閏十一月己丑 is not in this chapter unit; using the reception as Yuan Di’s death, then printing that day as an active hint, violates the reception/life split. The imperial-annals day exists and the intercalary month falls in January AD 323, but that witness is not s0336.
findings.action: Remove or re-source the death row so it does not cite s0336 for the day-date. Keep claim-468 as the contested Guzang reception. Clear the AD 323 active hint.

findings.problem: The AD 316 (Jianxing 4) hint treats Emperor Min’s death year as living activity. Owned rows are an undated naming and a 316–318 崩問 reception.
findings.action: Empty the active hints. Keep claim-141 undated and claim-453 as retrospective reception; do not feed context death into activity.

findings.problem: Fan Yi’s 少帝 speech is under 太寧元年, the same heading claim-195 and claim-468 correctly mark unresolved against Tongjian 太寧三年. Printing sourceDate 太寧元年 without unresolved treats a contested reception heading as settled.
findings.action: Add unresolved:true and the Taining 1 vs Tongjian Taining 3 reason already used on claim-195/468. Keep empty hints.

findings.problem: s0317 writes 十歲能屬文 as well as 及統任，年十八. The 18-sui command age is recorded; the childhood 十歲 age is omitted. Inclusive sui must not be converted to a birth year.
findings.action: Add an age row for 十歲 / traditional-inclusive on s0317, without deriving a birth year.

findings.problem: 咸和初 is an era-opening label, not a closed AD 326–327 / Xianhe 1 window. s0450–s0454 (及曜攻枹罕, 至是擒趙貞, 及石勒殺劉曜, 勒遣使, 後稱臣) have no new year and cannot be folded into that interval.
findings.action: Replace claim-230’s westernInterval 326–327 with an unresolved 咸和初 bound (onOrAfter AD 326) for the opening act only, or split the sequels; set hints-p190 to AD 326+ (咸和初) without a 327 endpoint.

findings.problem: s0488 馬岌上言 has no 永和元年 of its own. Closing AD 345–345 chooses a same-year attachment and creates false precision beside the undated death notice that follows.
findings.action: Change claim-257 to unresolved westernBounds onOrAfter 345 (and onOrBefore 346 if the death sequence is used as an upper bound). Do not keep a closed 345–345 year. Align hints-p211 to AD 345+.

findings.problem: Owned units state these deaths (殺劉曜; 自刎而死; 戮李嘉; 斬杜勳、汲魚; 弘、悠皆沒) but there is no death predicate. Birth/death must stay separate from the surviving attestation rows.
findings.action: Add death claims on those person IDs from the cited Chinese, using the same unresolved bounds as the host narrative (onOrAfter 326 for 殺劉曜; onOrAfter 346 after 永和二年 for the others). Do not import 329, 353, or any other external year.

findings.problem: Yi Chuai, Zhang Ling, and Zhang Song are dated as Yonghe 11 / AD 355–355, but the cited Chinese never writes 永和十一年. Jinshu only places those acts after 永和十年 and with 建興四十三年 at the restoration, the same 354–355 sandwich already used for Zuo's fall. ZZTJ's 永和十一年閏月 is a competing witness, not a Jinshu sourceDate.
findings.action: Replace the Yonghe 11 closed year with sourceDate after 永和十年 / by 建興四十三年 and westernBounds onOrAfter 354, onOrBefore 355. Keep ZZTJ 355 as a competing reading in the reason, not as the sole certified year. Synchronize the three hints.

findings.problem: The Lian Qi–Li Yan–Wang Meng campaign and Dahuai's heir appointment are locked to Taihe 1 / AD 366–366. Jinshu dates only 太和初 at the earlier Jin appointment; s0763–s0769 have no year. Zizhi Tongjian puts the fight in Taihe 2 (367); a 晉記 witness puts it in Taihe 3 spring (368). 366–366 is false precision.
findings.action: Do not certify 366. Use onOrAfter 366 from 太和初 and a before/onOrBefore 376 bound from 太元元年, or mark unresolved with both external years. Keep the conflict; do not pick 367 or 368. Move Dahuai's appointment off 太和初. Synchronize the five hints.

findings.problem: Chang Ju's attestation uses a Taiyuan 1 / 376–376 interval while citing s0765, where he is already 征東將軍 in the earlier undated campaign.
findings.action: Drop s0765 from the Taiyuan 1 attestation, or give the earlier appearance its own undated/太和初-floored claim. Keep the Taiyuan 1 death (claim-561) unchanged.

findings.action: Add dated events for the Taiyuan 1 fall and Fei River return, add a retrospective 追贈 reception from s0821, and extend hints-p332 with 376 and 383. Leave death unresolved.

references.reason: Confirms 太寧 = AD 323–326, so the Jin Shu / Tongjian Taining 1–3 conflict is AD 323 / 324 / 325, not a license to pick one year.

references.title: 中國歷代年號表 - 教育部《重編國語辭典修訂本》2021
references.reason: Confirms 咸和 opens in AD 326. 咸和初 names the era opening; it is not a closed 326–327 interval.

references.title: 資治通鑒 (胡三省音注) 卷093
references.quote: 夏，五月，甲申，張茂疾病
references.reason: Tongjian under 太寧二年 dates Zhang Mao’s death 夏五月甲申…是日薨, the competing witness to Jin Shu 太寧三年卒.

references.title: 資治通鑒 (胡三省音注) 卷093
references.quote: 春，正月，張駿承元帝凶問，大臨三日。
references.reason: Tongjian under 太寧三年 dates Jun’s receipt of Yuan Di’s death-news, competing with Jin Shu 太寧元年 尋承.

references.title: 資治通鑒 (胡三省音注) 卷093
references.quote: 十二月，涼州將辛晏據枹罕，不服
references.reason: Tongjian under 太寧二年 December places the Fuhan / Wang Zhi block, competing with Jin Shu’s placement before 太寧元年.

references.title: 资治通鉴 (胡三省音注) 卷093
references.quote: 二年（丁亥、三二七）
references.reason: Tongjian heads the Qinzhou/Wogan campaign 咸和二年 / AD 327, a competing witness to Jin Shu 咸和初 that must not be silently printed as a closed 326–327 interval.

references.title: 资治通鉴 (胡三省音注) 卷093
references.quote: 遣武威太守窦涛、金城太守张阆、武兴太守辛岩

references.quote: 闰月己丑，帝崩于内殿

references.title: 晉元帝 Jinyuandi - Chinese Text Project
references.quote: 永昌元年闰十一月己丑 323/1/3
references.reason: Conversion witness that 永昌元年閏十一月己丑 falls on 3 January AD 323. The conventional reign-year label 永昌元年 = 322 does not date this intercalary month. This does not authorize citing s0336 for the death day.

references.title: 咸和 (东晋)
references.quote: 咸和（ 326年二月—334年）是东晋皇帝晉成帝司馬衍的第一个年号，共计9年。
references.reason: Confirms Jin Cheng, 咸和, AD 326–334. Conventional year-only labels: 咸和元年/初 lower bound 326; 八年=333; 九年=334. 初 is not rewritten as years 1–2. Year-only events keep the conventional Western year; no month/day here needs a Julian-to-proleptic-Gregorian shift.

references.title: 咸和 (东晋) 紀年表
references.quote: | 咸和八年 | 癸巳 | 333年 |
references.reason: Table row for 咸和八年 = 公元 333. Same page gives 咸和九年 = 334. These numbered-year conversions support claim-248/496/502 (333) and claim-495/497/503 (334).

references.title: 永和 (东晋)
references.quote: 永和（ 345年—356年）是东晋皇帝晉穆帝司馬聃的第一个年号，共计12年。
references.reason: Confirms Jin Mu, 永和, AD 345–356. Conventional 永和元年=345 and 二年=346. Unnumbered sequels after 永和二年 stay onOrAfter 346 and are not closed as later Yonghe years.

references.title: 永和 (东晋) 紀年表
references.quote: | 永和二年 | 丙午 | 346年 |
references.reason: Table row for 永和二年 = 公元 346. Same page gives 永和元年 = 345. Supports the closed accession/appointment years and the 346 lower bound for later sequels.

references.title: 大兴 (东晋)
references.quote: 大兴（或作太兴； 318年三月—321年）是东晋皇帝晉元帝司馬睿的第二个年号，共计4年。
references.reason: Confirms Jin Yuan, 太興/大兴, AD 318–321, so 太興二年 = AD 319 for Geng Fang’s arrival. 建興中 remains unresolved because it is a mid-era label without a year number.

references.title: 中国历代年号索引表

references.quote: 三月，张天锡遣前将军杨遹向金城
